markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Invasive, and the second model and all 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, 90% level | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association in this case [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Second-strongest validated concept association [F4] · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 5, 7) · context · Higher than 95% of reference images [F8] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 6, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Score high, but failed spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to track the classifier; mitoses is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 11 (47% invasive) holds a separate non-invasive lesion.
- The 0th-percentile nuclear size (regions 1, 5, 7) [F7] reflects artifact or segmentation error.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5**: confirm tumor infiltrating stroma, not in-situ growth.
2. **Regions 6, 7, 10**: count mitoses yourself; the model's mitosis score failed its spot check.
3. **Region 11**: look for non-invasive or inflammatory tissue; the model gives only 47% invasive.
